subject: Request: Updated Subprocessor Inventory + Rollout Checklist
messages:
From: Kate Lin <kate.lin@finops.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finops.co>
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Updated subprocessor inventory and timeline for rollout

Hi Marissa,

We’re kicking off a security review ahead of our Q4 rollout and procurement asked me to collect the most recent subprocessor inventory for Redwood. Can you share the current list (vendors, country of processing, purpose, and whether they process customer content or metadata)?

Two quick constraints from our side:
- We need evidence that any KMS/HSM providers have SOC2 or equivalent controls (or a short attestation).
- Any vendors that transfer EU-origin data outside the EU need their transfer mechanism documented.

Timing: procurement would like the packet by EOD Friday 10/20 so legal can finish the playbook next week. If you cannot make that, please let me know the earliest you can deliver and whether you can provide a redacted CSV first.

Also, if there are new temporary processors or demo/test partners that will be in scope for the rollout, highlight those separately.

Thanks — Kate
Kate Lin
Sr. Procurement Manager, FinOps, Inc.
kate.lin@finops.co | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate.lin@finops.co>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Updated subprocessor inventory and timeline for rollout

Hi Kate — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Jonas (legal) and Ben (security ops) to assemble the packet.

We can provide:
- CSV export with vendor, processing country, purpose, data types (customer content / metadata), and transfer mechanisms.
- DPA summary page that lists active subprocessors and their accreditation.
- Short attestation for KMS/HSM partners where available.

Questions:
1) Is a redacted CSV acceptable for initial review (we can remove account-level identifiers)?
2) Are you expecting architecture diagrams or just the roster and transfer docs?

We’ll aim to get a redacted CSV + DPA summary to you by EOD Friday 10/20. If anything comes up, I’ll flag it immediately.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kate Lin <kate.lin@finops.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Updated subprocessor inventory and timeline for rollout

Hi all — attaching the requested artifacts.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_2028Q3.csv, dpa_summary_oct2028.pdf

Notes / quick summary:
- CSV includes: vendor name, service category (telemetry, storage, KMS, CDN, analytics), primary country of processing, transfer mechanism (SCCs / adequacy / onshore fallback), and a flag for whether the vendor handles customer-provided content.
- KMS/HSM: we rely on two providers; both maintain SOC2 Type II and provide customer-facing attestations. See DPA summary page, section 3.
- Temporary/demo processors: two demo partners (EdgeSim Labs and TestHarness Inc.) are marked in the CSV as \"temporary\" with start/end dates; they have stricter data minimization applied (no PII persisted).

Open items we flagged for procurement/legal to note:
- EdgeSim’s transfer mechanism uses SCCs but routes telemetry through an EU-registered intermediary; legal is validating the chain-of-transfer (expected complete by 10/22).
- One CDN provider has an upcoming subprocessor change planned for late November — vendor notified us 10/02; we plan to publish formal notice by 10/25.

Kate — if redaction is needed before you distribute within FinOps, let us know which columns you need removed and we’ll produce a redacted copy by EOD.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Kate Lin <kate.lin@finops.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finops.co>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Updated subprocessor inventory and timeline for rollout

Jonas / Marissa — really helpful, thank you. We received the attachments and the summary looks good. A couple of follow-ups before we close the packet: 

- Please send the short attestation for the two KMS/HSM providers (either the vendor attestation or SOC2 report redaction). If redaction is necessary, a summary of controls with dates will suffice.
- For the CDN vendor change you mentioned: can you provide the vendor notice and the planned mitigation steps (onshore fallback + rollback window)? Procurement wants to capture that in the risk register.

We may want a 20-min alignment call Monday morning (10/22) to confirm items if that works for you. If so, send a calendar invite; otherwise we can handle via email.

Thanks again — Kate
Kate Lin
Sr. Procurement Manager, FinOps, Inc.
